name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
name_mr: जल जीवन मिशन (हर घर जल) व ग्रामीण पाणी पुरवठा योजना
department: Rural Water Supply & Sanitation Department / Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Functional tap water connection providing 55 litres per person per day to every rural household.
eligibility: Rural household in registered Gram Panchayat
Lack of individual tap connection or non-functional village standpost

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
name_mr: प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना - ग्रामीण (PMAY-G) व घरकुल योजना
department: Rural Development Department / Gram Panchayat Housing Cell
description: Financial assistance of Rs 1.20 Lakhs for pucca house construction to rural houseless families.
eligibility: Houseless or living in kutcha house with 0-2 rooms
documents: Aadhaar Card of all adult members

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Agricultural Pump Scheme
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy / State DISCOM
description: Up to 90% subsidy for installation of solar pumps for farm irrigation to avoid nighttime load shedding.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship (MahaDBT / National Scholarship Portal)
name_mr: महाडीबीटी शिष्यवृत्ती व राष्ट्रीय शिष्यवृत्ती पोर्टल
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय छात्रवृत्ति पोर्टल (NSP) एवं राज्य छात्रवृत्ति
description: Tuition and maintenance allowance for higher education to economically weaker and reserved category students.
eligibility: Regular enrolled student in recognized college
Annual family income within prescribed bracket
documents: Aadhaar linked to bank account (NPCI DBT active)

name: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
name_mr: प्रधानमंत्री ग्राम सडक योजना (PMGSY) व ग्रामीण रस्ता सुधारणा
department: Public Works Department (PWD) / Zilla Parishad Works
description: All-weather blacktopped road connectivity to rural villages and repair of damaged arterial village routes.
eligibility: Rural habitation connection requiring pothole repair or all-weather road
documents: Gram Panchayat resolution or signed citizen petition

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension & Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar
name_mr: संजय गांधी निराधार योजना व राष्ट्रीय वृद्धापकाळ पेन्शन
description: Monthly DBT financial pension of Rs 1,500 to destitute, elderly (65+ yrs), and widows.
documents: Age Proof / School Leaving / Medical Certificate
